source.description_exact: When your Story sparks collab requests, your automation’s got answers — so you don’t have to copy-paste all day
source.preview_text_exact:
Instagram
Get more collabs from Story replies
When your Story sparks collab requests, your automation’s got answers — so you don’t have to copy-paste all day
Business value
Set it and forget it. When someone replies to your Story, your automation dishes out the info — whatever you’re sick of typing.
How does it work?

Someone saw your Story now they’re asking about collabs? Dream. Come. True. Check if you’ve got their email, and auto-respond with info about your collabs — whatever you’re usually typing 20 times in a row. It feels personal but scales like a dream.

graph_integrity.limitation: Original graph is not exposed. Draft edges use visible navigation identity; no hidden IDs or server export.

selection.choose_when: Use collaboration Story replies with email collection only when Email has no value.
selection.avoid_when: Do not collect again for existing-email contacts. No outbound email or teammate assignment is implemented.

safety.delivery_limit: No Set Live or send action. Scoped 0 runs before trigger removal and n/a list metrics are not account-wide no-delivery proof.

gaps: Original server settings and IDs were not exported. Clone defaults are not asserted to equal source defaults.
Runtime was not tested because execution is forbidden; this is separate from settings completeness.
All existing node defaults were opened. Shared options are evidence-matched; exhaustive alternative node-type conversion is not proven.
